rlcar.camera.title: RL Car Camera
rlcar.camera.fov.tooltip: Horizontal field of view in degrees at 16:9, as in Rocket League. It widens a little with speed and when supersonic. Replaces Minecraft's FOV while in the car camera.
rlcar.camera.distance.tooltip: How far the camera sits from the car (Rocket League units, 100 = 1 block).
rlcar.camera.height.tooltip: How high above the car the camera looks (Rocket League units).
rlcar.camera.angle.tooltip: Camera pitch in degrees; lower looks further down.
rlcar.camera.stiffness.tooltip: How rigidly the camera follows the car: lower lets it lag behind and pull back at speed.
rlcar.camera.swivel_speed.tooltip: How fast the controller's right stick turns the camera around the car.
rlcar.camera.rear_camera_toggle.tooltip: Off: Rear Camera looks behind while held. On: each press of Rear Camera switches between looking behind and forward.
